title: Agent Onboarding Requirement
description: One requirement an onboarding mode imposes, discriminated by kind. Only aao_verified, storyboard, and experimental_feature carry fields; other kinds are the kind alone. The aao_verified fields (role, verification_modes, verified_specialisms, adcp_version) use the AgenticAdvertising.org Verified badge token's own claim names (docs/building/verification/aao-verified.mdx). The requirement describes the gate the publishing party applies on its own side; it creates no conformance obligation on the counterparty.

role.description: aao_verified: the badge role required, such as media-buy.

verification_modes.description: aao_verified: accepted verification modes, as the badge token names them.

verified_specialisms.description: aao_verified: specialisms the badge's verified_specialisms claim must include.

adcp_version.description: aao_verified: the AdCP release the badge must cover.

id.description: storyboard: the storyboard id. experimental_feature: the feature id.
